extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.21.0 Sleep timer: the screen overlay is gone — it could deadlock Kodi's UI after the timer expired, unrecoverably. The timer now uses Kodi's own screensaver and restores your screensaver settings afterwards. Screen off (HDMI-CEC) removed; the Android screen-off option is renamed to Linux/X11 only, which is where DPMS actually exists. New "Screensaver: my usual one" mode. Fixes: the idle-seconds setting dependency never parsed; Settings and unknown routes left their directory handle open; a trailing slash on any parameter but the last broke the route.
